resources.string: Allows the local assistant to read on-screen content and perform taps/gestures/settings changes that you ask for. Everything runs on-device; nothing is sent anywhere.
No model loaded yet. Tap \"Load model\" to pick a .litertlm file already on your device, or \"Download model\" to fetch one from Hugging Face.
Hugging Face access token (required - Gemma models are gated)
